info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, radians, Ypos, mapXPos, swell, swellList, swellListPointer, COPTER, sway, bellRung, loopX, loopWidthglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gScore, gFlyingPointson beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  COPTER = sprite(4)  swellList = []  flyingPoints = sprite(3)  repeat with i = 1 to 90    swellAngle = 4 * i    swellList.add(5 * cos(swellAngle * radians))  end repeat  swellListPointer = 1  swell = 0  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  this.locZ = 50  mapXPos = Xpos - 256  sway = 0  swellAngle = 0  bellRung = 0endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    if (Xpos > 0) and (Xpos < 512) then      xDiff = COPTER.locH - this.locH      if abs(xDiff) < 20 then        yDiff = COPTER.locV - this.locV        if (yDiff > -150) and (yDiff < -60) then          sway = sway + 0.16        end if      end if    end if    sway = sway - (this.rotation * 0.01)    sway = sway * 0.98999999999999999    this.rotation = this.rotation + sway    if abs(this.rotation) > 20 then      if bellRung = 0 then        bellRung = 1        puppetSound(4, member(26, "Sfx"))        gScore = gScore + 100        gFlyingPoints = 100      end if    end if    swellListPointer = swellListPointer + 1    if swellListPointer > 90 then      swellListPointer = 1    end if    this.locH = Xpos    this.locV = Ypos + swellList[swellListPointer]  end ifend
info.name: Bell Buoy
